words.definition: Cambiar para ajustarse a una nueva situación.
words.example: Los animales deben adaptarse para sobrevivir en la naturaleza.

gloss.en: To change in order to fit a new situation

gloss_example.en: Animals must adapt to survive in the wild.

words.definition: Considerar algo o a alguien con respeto, placer o satisfacción.

gloss.en: To regard with respect, pleasure, or satisfaction

gloss_example.en: I admire her dedication to her work.

words.definition: Aceptar algo como verdadero sin pruebas.
words.example: No des por supuesto que sabes la respuesta.

gloss.en: To accept something as true without proof

gloss_example.en: Do not assume you know the answer.

words.definition: Dedicarte a algo o comprometerte a hacerlo.
words.example: Se comprometió a aprender inglés cada día.

gloss.en: To dedicate yourself to something or pledge to do it

gloss_example.en: She committed to learning English every day.

words.definition: Destinar tiempo y esfuerzo a un propósito.
words.example: Dedicó años a dominar el piano.

gloss.en: To devote time and effort to a purpose

gloss_example.en: She dedicated years to mastering the piano.

words.definition: Recorrer un lugar desconocido o investigar algo.
words.example: Nos encanta explorar ciudades nuevas en las vacaciones.

gloss.en: To travel through an unfamiliar area or investigate something

gloss_example.en: We love to explore new cities on vacation.

words.definition: Concentrar la atención o el esfuerzo en algo.
words.example: Intenta enfocarte en una tarea a la vez.

gloss.en: To concentrate attention or effort on something

gloss_example.en: Try to focus on one task at a time.

words.definition: Seleccionar y enfatizar las partes más importantes.
words.example: Destacó los puntos clave del informe.

gloss.en: To pick out and emphasize the most important parts

gloss_example.en: She highlighted the key points in the report.

words.definition: Reconocer o establecer quién o qué es algo.

gloss.en: To recognize or establish who or what something is

gloss_example.en: Can you identify the main problem here?

words.example: La práctica regular mejorará tu pronunciación.

gloss.en: To make or become better

gloss_example.en: Regular practice will improve your pronunciation.

words.definition: Llenar a alguien de deseo o capacidad para hacer algo.
words.example: Los grandes maestros inspiran a los estudiantes a pensar con libertad.

gloss.en: To fill someone with the urge or ability to do something

gloss_example.en: Great teachers inspire students to think freely.

words.definition: Mantener en buen estado, continuar haciendo algo.

gloss.en: To keep in good condition, to continue doing something

gloss_example.en: It is important to maintain good habits.

words.definition: Dar a alguien una razón o incentivo para actuar.
words.example: Un buen entrenador sabe cómo motivar a un equipo.

gloss.en: To give someone a reason or incentive to act

gloss_example.en: A good coach knows how to motivate a team.

words.definition: Identificar a alguien a partir de una experiencia previa.

gloss.en: To identify someone or something from previous experience

gloss_example.en: I recognized his voice immediately.

words.definition: Hacer grandes esfuerzos para superar dificultades.
words.example: Mucha gente lucha con hablar en público.

gloss.en: To make forceful efforts against difficulties

gloss_example.en: Many people struggle with public speaking.

words.example: Por favor, ven aquí un momento.

gloss.en: To move toward the person who is speaking.

gloss_example.en: Please come here for a moment.

words.definition: Empezar a ser algo con el tiempo.
words.example: Se convirtió en médica tras seis años.

gloss.en: To start to be something over time.

gloss_example.en: She became a doctor after six years.

words.example: El accidente ocurrió cerca del puente.

gloss.en: To take place, often without being planned.

gloss_example.en: The accident happened near the bridge.

words.definition: Traer algo a la mente o guardarlo.
words.example: No puedo recordar su número de teléfono.

gloss.en: To keep something in your mind or bring it back.

gloss_example.en: I can't remember her phone number.

gloss.en: To make a choice after thinking about it.

gloss_example.en: They decided to move to another city.

words.definition: Usar dinero para pagar, o usar tiempo.
words.example: Pasamos toda la tarde en el museo.

gloss.en: To use money to pay for things, or to use time.

gloss_example.en: We spent the whole afternoon at the museum.

words.definition: Tomar una cosa entre varias posibilidades.
words.example: Puedes elegir el postre que quieras.

gloss.en: To pick one thing from several possibilities.

gloss_example.en: You can choose any dessert you like.

words.definition: Desear algo, o sentir cariño por alguien.

gloss.en: To wish for something, or to feel affection.

gloss_example.en: I want to learn to cook.

words.example: No sé dónde está la salida.

gloss.en: To have knowledge of something.

gloss_example.en: I don't know where the exit is.

words.definition: Tener vida, o residir en un lugar.

gloss.en: To be alive, or to reside somewhere.

gloss_example.en: I live near my job.

gloss.en: To form ideas in the mind.

gloss_example.en: I think you are right.

gloss.en: To direct your eyes toward something.

gloss_example.en: Look at that pretty bird.

gloss.en: To request information from someone.

gloss_example.en: I am going to ask for the time.

gloss.en: To go from outside to inside.

gloss_example.en: Come in, the door is open.

words.example: No te oigo bien, habla más fuerte.

gloss.en: To perceive sounds with your ears.

gloss_example.en: I can't hear you well, speak louder.

words.definition: Gustar más una cosa que otra.

gloss.en: To like one thing more than another.

gloss_example.en: I prefer tea to coffee.

words.definition: Mostrar alegría con sonidos y gestos.
words.example: Nos reímos mucho con la película.

gloss.en: To show joy with sounds and expressions.

gloss_example.en: We laughed a lot at the movie.

words.definition: Soltar lágrimas por tristeza o emoción.
words.example: El bebé llora cuando tiene hambre.

gloss.en: To shed tears from sadness or emotion.

gloss_example.en: The baby cries when it is hungry.

words.definition: Andar a pie de un lugar a otro.

gloss.en: To go on foot from one place to another.

gloss_example.en: We walked to the square.

words.example: Me gusta caminar por la playa.

gloss.en: To find something pleasant.

gloss_example.en: I like walking on the beach.

words.definition: Apoyar el cuerpo sobre las nalgas.
words.example: Se sentó junto a la ventana.

gloss.en: To rest with your weight on your bottom.

gloss_example.en: She sat down by the window.

words.definition: Subir algo o ponerlo más alto.

gloss.en: To move something to a higher place.

gloss_example.en: He lifted the box carefully.

words.example: Los niños se divirtieron en el parque.

gloss.en: To have a good time.

gloss_example.en: The children had fun at the park.

words.definition: Hacer algo con frecuencia para mejorar.

gloss.en: To do something regularly to improve.

gloss_example.en: I practice Spanish every day.

gloss.en: To look carefully at something.

gloss_example.en: She watched the sky for hours.

words.definition: Tener un precio, o ser difícil.

gloss.en: To have a price, or to be hard.

gloss_example.en: How much does the ticket cost?

gloss.en: To speak very loudly.

gloss_example.en: Don't shout, I can hear you fine.

words.definition: Causar dolor una parte del cuerpo.

gloss.en: To feel pain in a part of the body.

gloss_example.en: My head hurts.

words.definition: Empezar a vivir, salir al mundo.

gloss.en: To come into life.

gloss_example.en: My daughter was born in March.

gloss.en: To make someone want to know more.

gloss_example.en: I am interested in science.

gloss.en: To like something very much.

gloss_example.en: I love this song.

words.definition: Responder a una pregunta o llamada.

gloss.en: To reply to a question or call.

gloss_example.en: Answer the phone, please.

gloss.en: To put color on with paint.

gloss_example.en: They painted the house white.

gloss.en: To rest and calm down.

gloss_example.en: I relax by listening to music.

gloss.en: To throw something, or to drop it.

gloss_example.en: Don't throw trash on the ground.

words.definition: Tomar algo que no es tuyo.

gloss.en: To take something that is not yours.

gloss_example.en: They stole his phone.

translations.en: to go to bed / to lie down

gloss.en: To lie down to sleep or rest.

gloss_example.en: I go to bed at eleven.

gloss.en: To mark an important event with joy.

gloss_example.en: We celebrated her birthday.

words.example: Organizamos una reunión para el viernes.

gloss.en: To arrange and prepare something.

gloss_example.en: We organized a meeting for Friday.

words.definition: Existir o tener una cualidad esencial.

gloss.en: To exist or have an essential quality.

gloss_example.en: She is very kind.

gloss.en: To possess something.

gloss_example.en: I have two brothers.

gloss.en: To create or carry out an action.

gloss_example.en: I make lunch every day.

gloss.en: To move toward a place.

gloss_example.en: I go to school.

gloss.en: To express something in words.

gloss_example.en: Tell me the truth.

gloss.en: To perceive with the eyes.

gloss_example.en: I can see the sea from here.

gloss.en: To hand something to someone.

gloss_example.en: Give me the book, please.

gloss.en: To communicate with words.

gloss_example.en: I speak two languages.

words.definition: Encontrarse en un lugar o estado.

gloss.en: To be in a place or state.

gloss_example.en: I am at home.

words.example: Pon el vaso en la mesa.

gloss.en: To place something somewhere.

gloss_example.en: Put the glass on the table.

gloss.en: To discover something you look for.

gloss_example.en: I can't find my keys.

gloss.en: To begin something.

gloss_example.en: I start work early.

words.example: Salgo de casa a las ocho.

gloss.en: To go out of a place.

gloss_example.en: I leave home at eight.

gloss.en: To accept something as true.

gloss_example.en: I believe you.

gloss.en: To take in food.

gloss_example.en: I eat fruit every day.
